reason: The official Planning Data geometry_entity/intersects route is materially different from the prior coordinate point-query route because it uses the complete authoritative Forge Cottage outline geometry rather than a point. The API documentation supports geometry_entity and intersects, but this transport cannot access the exact custom title-boundary query URL and therefore returned no target-specific title-boundary entity. No canonical parcel ID, geometry or bbox is asserted, and spatial join/materialization remains local OpenCode work.
